## Change

Describe the project addition or correction and why it belongs.

## Evidence

Link primary sources for the affected claims, including connectome, scale, neural model, inputs, outputs, and closed-loop status when relevant. Mark unknown details explicitly.

## Checklist

- [ ] I read CONTRIBUTING.md and checked for duplicates.
- [ ] Any added project exists, fits the scope, and has inspectable technical evidence.
- [ ] I did not add wanted entries or placeholder categories.
- [ ] I preserved the table format and used direct project links where possible.
- [ ] Counts and capabilities are supported by sources; reported claims are distinguished from independently reproduced results.
- [ ] Descriptions are factual and concise, with relevant limitations stated.
